question: provenance of every Qwen baseline-six result; where did the remembered 6/6 come from
method: read model_decision for the 6 baseline cases from every saved eval_*.json in reports/slm_comparison/v4
finding: the 6/6 result belongs to Qwen round TWO and round THREE, never round one. round one is 4/6 in ALL four of its saved evaluations. this is a documentation/memory attribution issue, NOT an artifact mismatch: every raw artifact is internally self-consistent (r1 always 4/6, r2 always 6/6, r3 6/6).
verdict: DOCUMENTATION/MEMORY ISSUE, not artifact mismatch. r2 and r3 (over-conservative / erratic on other metrics) each scored 6/6 on baseline six; r1 (the checkpoint chosen as the official pure-FT arm for its balance on other metrics) scored 4/6. The v1 selection of r1 as official was made on the full metric picture, not baseline-six alone, so it stands. No historical raw artifact needs correction; only summaries that attributed 6/6 to r1 were wrong.
